theorems.name: Submission.bf_haar_excPointwise_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (Exc : Set (Rn (n + ℓ) × (Rn (n + ℓ) →L[ℝ] Rn (n + ℓ)))) (Bad : Set (Rn (n + ℓ) × (Rn (n + ℓ) →L[ℝ] Rn (n + ℓ)) × Rn (n + ℓ))), MeasurableSet Bad → (∀ H : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ)), finrank ℝ H = n + 1 → 0 < μHE[n] {x : Rn (n + ℓ) | x ∈ H ∧ ‖x‖ = 1} ∧ μHE[n] {x : Rn (n + ℓ) | x ∈ H ∧ ‖x‖ = 1} < ∞) → ∀ a : Rn (n + ℓ), (∀ H : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ)), finrank ℝ H = n + 1 → μHE[n] {x | x ∈ H ∧ ‖x‖ = 1 ∧ (a, H.starProjection, x) ∈ Bad} = 0) → (∀ W : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ)), finrank ℝ W = n → (a, W.starProjection) ∈ Exc → ∀ u : Fin ℓ → Rn (n + ℓ), Orthonormal ℝ u → (∀ j, u j ∈ Wᗮ) → ∃ j, (a, (W ⊔ Submodule.span ℝ {u j}).starProjection, u j) ∈ Bad) → ∀ θ : Measure (Rn (n + ℓ) →L[ℝ] Rn (n + ℓ)), IsProbabilityMeasure θ → (∀ᵐ g ∂θ, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g * g = 1) → (∀ k : Rn (n + ℓ) →L[ℝ] Rn (n + ℓ), ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint k * k = 1 → Measure.map (fun g ↦ g * k) θ = θ) → ∀ W₀ : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ)), finrank ℝ W₀ = n → θ {g | (a, g * W₀.starProjection * ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint g) ∈ Exc} = 0
